title: Bagatelle "Für Elise" a minor WoO 59
analyzer_led_note: Inspect the top analyzer-selected section for repeated accompaniment figuration against the familiar melody.
user_selected_note: Walk through the opening 16 bars by hand to show manual passage selection on material the reviewer already knows.
disagreement_note: If the reviewer finds the opening easy but the ranking highlights it, frame the ranking as relative within-piece demand, not a learner grade.
caveat_note: Within-piece ranks only; familiarity with the tune is not evidence of playing ease.

title: Bagatelle A major op. 119 no. 10
analyzer_led_note: Compare the analyzer-selected sections against the existing preview previously shown for this piece.
user_selected_note: Select a short phrase manually to demonstrate that user regions work with or without a computed hotspot.
disagreement_note: If the reviewer expects this to feel easy, keep the system ranking separate from any learner self-report.
caveat_note: Short bagatelle; few windows means peaks are suggestive, not statistically strong.

title: Piano Sonata "Facile" C major KV 545, 1st movement (Allegro)
analyzer_led_note: Inspect how scalic passages and Alberti-style textures separate across factor tracks in the top section.
user_selected_note: Walk through the exposition opening to show clean classical texture under manual selection.
disagreement_note: A learner calling the opening 'easy' does not overrule a ranking driven by onset density; show both side by side.
caveat_note: First movement only; Henle label covers the sonata and is not a per-movement grade.

title: Waltz a minor KK IVb,11
analyzer_led_note: Check whether the left-hand waltz pattern or the cantabile line dominates the top ranked section.
user_selected_note: Select the returning main theme to frame a help request on phrasing over a steady accompaniment.
disagreement_note: Use this piece to rehearse the line: the system shows measured demands, the learner decides what is hard.
caveat_note: Posthumous salon piece; edition differences may shift measure numbers against other sources.

title: Prelude e minor op. 28 no. 4
analyzer_led_note: Inspect the top section for chromatic harmony load versus the slow, technically simple surface.
user_selected_note: Select the climactic bars manually to show expression-heavy material that is not finger-heavy.
disagreement_note: If a learner reports this as emotionally hard but the ranking is flat, the ranking measures symbolic demand only.
caveat_note: Slow tempo means onset-density factors stay low; do not read flat profiles as 'easy to interpret'.

title: Prelude A major op. 28 no. 7
analyzer_led_note: Use this very short prelude as a control: check that few windows still yield a readable summary.
user_selected_note: Select the whole piece manually to show manual-region help on miniature material.
disagreement_note: Any mismatch between reviewer expectation and ranking here illustrates window-count limits, not learner error.
caveat_note: Only 16 bars; candidate sections are illustrative and sensitive to window settings.

title: Arabesque no. 1
analyzer_led_note: Inspect the flowing triplet/arpeggiated sections for onset-density and span contributions.
user_selected_note: Walk through the opening arpeggiation to show continuous-texture material under manual selection.
disagreement_note: A learner fluent in arpeggiation may disagree with a density-driven ranking; keep the report framing verbatim.
caveat_note: Ornamental timing is approximate in symbolic data; rubato and tone are out of scope.

title: Gymnopédie no. 1
analyzer_led_note: Use as a sparse baseline: expect low, flat factor tracks and possibly no distinct peaks.
user_selected_note: Select the opening chords to demonstrate honest abstention when no hotspot supports a claim.
disagreement_note: If the reviewer finds sustained chords tiring, note the analyzer does not measure physical sustain effort.
caveat_note: Extreme sparseness may yield no candidate sections; that is a valid outcome, not a failure.
